title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Card Services Reference: Lost, Stolen and Damaged Cards
content:
**Report and request.** When a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards cardmember reports the card lost, stolen or damaged, customer care records a card service request for a card replacement with the replacement speed the cardmember chooses.

**New card number.** For a lost or stolen card the old card number is blocked at once and the replacement carries new last four digits; a damaged card is replaced with new last four digits as well.

**Speed and charge.** A standard replacement costs the card's standard replacement fee and arrives within the card's standard replacement business days; an expedited replacement costs the card's expedited replacement fee, assessed as an expedited replacement fee, and arrives within the card's expedited replacement business days.

**Charges the cardmember did not make.** Charges the cardmember did not make that posted before or after the report are handled as unauthorized-charge disputes under the billing error dispute terms.

**Account condition.** A replacement is not issued on an account in declined, closed or charged-off status.

**What a replacement leaves untouched.** Replacing the card never changes the credit line, balance, AutoPay or status.

## Judgement table

| Report | Account status | Replacement | Card number |
|---|---|---|---|
| lost | active | issued at the speed chosen | old number blocked at once; new last four digits |
| stolen | restricted | issued at the speed chosen | old number blocked at once; new last four digits |
| damaged | active | issued at the speed chosen | new last four digits |
| any | closed, charged-off or declined | not issued | — |

## Example (hypothetical card with an expedited fee of USD 15.00)

A cardmember whose card was stolen chooses expedited delivery: the old number is blocked at once, a USD 15.00 expedited replacement fee is assessed, and the card arrives within the card's expedited business days. Two charges the cardmember did not make, posted the day before the report, are handled as unauthorized-charge disputes.
